name: SAAS 275
title: Advanced Animal and Product Evaluation
description: Intensive training in the evaluation of selected species of farm animals or their products. Type standards and the relation of anatomical features to physiological function are emphasized. Evaluation skills including justification of decisions will be developed. Students enrolled in this course will have the option to participate on intercollegiate animal and product evaluation teams. Field trips are required, some of which may occur prior to the start of the semester. Taught with ANSC 3675. May be repeated for a total of 2 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
